description: A finite partial isomorphism preserves and reflects every quantifier-free formula on finite tuples from its domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso.quantifierFree.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N]
  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso L M N) {n : ℕ} (φ : L.Formula (Fin n))
  (hφ : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF φ) (a : Fin n → ↑p.dom) :
  φ.Realize (p.toFun ∘ a) ↔ φ.Realize (Subtype.val ∘ a)
